plan.title: What is a plan?
plan.body: A plan is a bundle of available features. There are three plans — Free, Basic, and Full — and higher plans unlock more features. Contracting a plan for a team or organization makes the features available to everyone in that team or organization.

addon.title: What is an add-on?
addon.body: Add-ons let you add a single feature individually instead of an entire plan. If you only need one feature, an add-on can be more economical than a full plan. Availability of add-ons varies by feature.

beta.title: During the beta period
beta.body: During the beta period, any plan or add-on with an undecided price is free to use. Official pricing will be decided after the beta ends and will be announced in advance. Free contracts made during the beta will never automatically switch to a paid contract.

betaGrant.title: Difference from beta perks
betaGrant.body: A "beta perk" granted individually by the operator is a separate mechanism from the plan/add-on contracts here. Beta perks are granted by the operator, not something you contract yourself. You can check the expiration of a perk on the billing management page.

about.title: What are beta perks?
about.body: Beta perks let you use certain features for free during the beta period. Separate from any plan or add-on you contract yourself, these are granted at our discretion.

autoGrant.title: How perks are granted (automatic)
autoGrant.body: Perks are granted automatically once activity conditions such as active days are met. There's no application form. You can check your progress toward eligibility in the progress bar above.

period.title: Duration and renewal
period.body: Personal perks are free for as long as the service is provided. Team/organization perks have an expiration date, and we'll notify you as it approaches. They do not renew automatically.

transfer.title: No transfers, and revocation
transfer.body: Perks can't be transferred between accounts. If you violate the terms of service, a perk may be revoked.
